## Phase 0 diagnosis

I pulled up the live site (`http://127.0.0.1:41795`), the GSC export, and the repo source. The big story: **this SaaS pivoted products** (old brand "InboxZap," an email-cleanup tool → new brand "Lumina," an AI meeting assistant) and the marketing site didn't fully follow.

| Lane | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SEO | ⚠️ | Technical basics (title/meta/OG/canonical/robots/sitemap) exist on most pages, but: `app/sitemap.ts` explicitly excludes all 12 blog posts (`// TODO: include blog posts once content API exposes a stable listing`); `app/blog/page.tsx` renders the post list client-side via `fetch('/api/posts')`, and that endpoint 404s live — so `/blog` shows a permanent loading spinner to anyone (and anything) not executing JS, orphaning every post from internal links; `app/layout.tsx` still carries the **old InboxZap title/description/OG image**, which would stomp the correct Lumina metadata on any page without its own `metadata` export (the homepage has none) — a live landmine for the next deploy. |
| AEO | ❌ | No FAQ structured data anywhere. `next.config.js` 301-redirects `/faq` → `/#faq`, but `app/page.tsx` has no `#faq` section — the redirect points at nothing. |
| GEO/LLMO | ❌ | `/llms.txt` → 404. |
| NEO | — | No Korean-market signal; skipping unless you want it in scope. |
| Content ops | ❌ | All 12 published posts (`post-1`…`post-12`) target the **old** product: inbox zero, bulk-delete emails, Gmail storage, unsubscribe, Outlook sweep, etc. Zero of them mention meetings/transcription/Lumina. |

**This explains the GSC pattern directly:** non-brand queries like "bulk delete emails," "gmail storage full," "unsubscribe from newsletters" get 300–1200 impressions but near-0 clicks at position 40–65 — they're legacy rankings for a product that no longer exists on this domain. Anyone who does click lands on a page branded "Lumina — AI meeting assistant" with no mention of email, an instant bounce. Meanwhile the *actual* product (meeting assistant) has zero query data in GSC yet — no content targets it at all.

## Proposed priority

1. **P0 — fix live bugs (pure engineering, no judgment calls):** stale InboxZap metadata in `app/layout.tsx`, broken client-only `/blog` + missing posts API, sitemap missing all blog posts, dead `/faq` redirect target.
2. **P1 — your call needed:** what to do with the 12 legacy InboxZap posts. My recommendation is to leave them technically sound but stop pretending they serve the current business — redirect/retire rather than force a fake "email ↔ meetings" bridge (that'd violate the "don't make the page claim something false" rule). The real growth lever is new intent-matched landing/blog content for actual Lumina queries (e.g. "AI meeting notes app," "automatic meeting summaries," "action items from Zoom calls"), since that's currently a blank slate.
3. **P2 — AEO/GEO basics:** build a real FAQ section + `FAQPage` JSON-LD, add `llms.txt`.

Want me to go ahead with P0 now, and do you have a preference on the legacy posts (redirect to homepage, retire with noindex, or something else) before I touch P1?
